routes: /browser-tests/configuration-migration.html (production transfer flow, dialogs, API client and toast consumer)
states: Missing/null/array/error/contradictory HTTP-success replies remain unconfirmed; bad exports with missing, blank or non-string archives never download or show success.
Unconfirmed imports preserve selected file/passphrase, warn settings may already have changed, and do not reload, retry or prompt for another token.
Acknowledged export downloads only status/data; acknowledged import uses the existing disabled/reloading state and ordinary reload.
interactions: Thirty synthetic transfer operations through real production consumers: eight malformed export and five malformed import replies, then two valid acknowledgements per viewport.
Native file selection/password input, keyboard Cancel, no implicit replay, preserved document identity for failures, actual downloaded archive-byte inspection and normal successful reload.
All six retained captures opened with native view_image at original detail and actual pixels inspected; light desktop and dark 320px touch WebKit.
limits: Safe synthetic HTTP responses and archive strings; response-envelope acknowledgement only, not decryption/restore integrity, full Settings route/auth journey, real server configuration replacement or guest health. The separate mobile-WebKit Docs history/reload path was not exercised or cleared.
